start: app.mettleup.fit welcome page on a phone, "Create my gym" form; checking by WhatsApp is on (the person sends a message)

steps.action: Type "Gym name", "Your name" and "Your mobile number"

must_not: More than 10 digits accepted

The gym made without the PIN or without the terms record

user_sees: The new gym opens

start: "Create my gym" form, empty

user_sees: "Type your name."
must_not: Any call to the server
